'''Void''' was a [[Silver/Legends|silver]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] owned by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roa]]. Void had escaped the [[Red Knights of Life]] on [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]], but the event was so traumatizing he needed a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] to function again. The wipe cost Roa 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], more than Void cost.
